declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees together from the outset. Hargrove Lane’s first proposal sought a $32 million class fund and $8 million in fees and expenses, with automatic payments, no clear-sailing commitment, and any unawarded fees benefiting the class. Brightline’s first proposal was $24 million for the class and $6 million in fees and expenses on the same distribution and fee-review terms. The parties exchanged further proposals, with the class fund and fee amount changing during the negotiations. In Round 3, Brightline proposed a $28 million class fund and $6.25 million in fees and expenses; Hargrove Lane accepted that term sheet in Round 4. The final agreement provides automatic payments to identified class members, no clear-sailing commitment, and that any fees the court does not award will benefit the class. The transcript reflects that fees were discussed alongside class relief, not only after class relief had been agreed.
